title: Flutter named in TIME's World's Best Companies 2026
summary: Flutter is ranked 41st globally, our highest placing to date, and our fourth consecutive appearance on the list.
body_markdown:
We are proud to announce that Flutter has been named in TIME's World's Best Companies 2026, ranked 41st globally.


Flutter has appeared on the list every year since TIME and Statista launched the ranking in 2023. This year's result is our strongest performance yet, building on our debut ranking of 597th in the inaugural edition.


Produced by TIME in partnership with Statista, the ranking evaluates companies across three areas: employee satisfaction, based on surveys of employees worldwide; financial performance, measured through revenue growth over multiple years; and sustainability transparency, assessed through publicly disclosed environmental, social and governance data.


There is no shortage of company rankings. What makes this one stand out is what it measures. Rather than focusing on brand awareness or public profile alone, it considers how employees view their workplace, how the business has performed, and how transparently it reports on its impact.


That makes this recognition particularly meaningful. It reflects the strength of our business, our long-term growth, and most importantly, the experience of colleagues across Flutter who continue to build and shape our success every day.


Coming from a title that has been taking the measure of business for more than a century, it is one of the few worth pausing on.


**Lisa Sewell, Chief People Officer at Flutter, said:** "Being recognized by TIME every year since this list began says something more durable than any single result. It reflects the work of colleagues across every brand and every market we operate in — the people who build our products, serve our customers and hold us to the standards we have set ourselves. This is their recognition, and I am hugely proud of them for it."


See the full TIME list[here.](https://time.com/article/2026/09/09/worlds-best-companies-of-2026/)
